Document.styles property returns copy instead of original styles object

#### Description

The `Document.styles` property is returning a copy of the styles object instead of the original styles object, breaking existing code that expects to get the same object reference.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Create a document
doc = Document()

# Get styles reference twice
styles1 = doc.styles
styles2 = doc.styles

# These should be the same object but they're not
print(styles1 is styles2)  # Expected: True, Actual: False
```

The issue appears when accessing the `styles` property multiple times - each access returns a different copy rather than the same styles object reference that was previously returned.
</issue>
